message:
The other day, we decided to go through our go-bags and check our supplies. It started as a chore, but then we found ourselves reminiscing about past camping trips and the snacks we couldn't live without. We even set up a little picnic in the living room, complete with our favorite treats and some cozy blankets. 

It was a lovely reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be all about seriousness or stress; it can also be about making memories together. Who knew a little inventory check could turn into a cozy family moment? 🌿
